name: Komorebi: Japanese Learning System
description: Comprehensive Japanese language learning system featuring two distinct course book features: かつどう (Communicative Activities, Lessons 1–18, Can-dos pp. 151–159, Answer Keys pp. 160–177) and りかい (Language Competences, Lessons 1–18, Vocabulary, Grammar, Reading, Writing & Answers), alongside official Vocabulary lists (Japanese, Kanji, English).
